notes.title: Patch Notes for Tragedy of Medusa 0.4
notes.content:
In Tragedy of Medusa 0.4, Queen Igret seduces Medusa and discovers her affinity to lust energy.  Perseus realizes just how important the gorgons are and resumes his mission to find them.

Changes:
[list]
[*] 5 new scenes
[*] Remastered renders for intro scene
[/list]

notes.title: Tragedy of Medusa 0.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
In ToM 0.3, Athena and Zeus meet with two succubus queens in order to form an alliance. Medusa and Euryale seek out their mother, Ceto for answers regarding Euryale's using of lust powers. A strange visitor washes ashore on the sister's island.

Changes (since 0.2):

[list]
[*] 12 new scenes
[*] Additional images to scene right before Medusa enters Athena's temple
[*] Re-edited Medusa + Athena's temple scene for more tension
[*] Dialog/narration fixes
[/list]
